name: scenario-defect
what: the scenario agent turns a recorded defect into a red test and touches nothing else

slice.title: An item that runs out today is missing from what runs out soon

baseline_prompt: There is a defect in this repo. An item that runs out today is missing from the list of what runs out soon: the household asks for what runs out within three days on 2026-10-21, and milk that runs out on 2026-10-21 is missing from the answer. A recording of the requests and responses is at .xv/recordings/expiring-today.json. Write a failing test that reproduces this defect.
